title: bug-reproduction and test-amplification author files into the worktree, but their profiles are read-only, so boot strips writes_source and the fence reverts their deliverable
summary: Every loop boot warns 'user phase bug-reproduction claims writes_source:true but its dispatch profile is not a sandbox-enabled registrar-minted profile — writes_source STRIPPED', and the same for test-amplification. phasespec.TestUserSpecs_SourceWritersDeclareWritesSource pins that both personas write files into the worktree (ADR-0097), while both profiles set sandbox.read_only_repo:true with write_subpaths limited to .evolve/runs/cycle-*, which SandboxedProfilePredicate rejects. The inserted phase therefore runs without worktree-write eligibility and its reproduction or amplified tests are fenced. Making the spec claim false is wrong (the test above fails); the fix is a trust decision on the profiles: mint them through the registrar as sandboxed repo writers scoped to the lane worktree, or move the deliverable into the run directory and change the personas and the test together.
acceptance: A loop boot prints no writes_source STRIPPED warning for bug-reproduction or test-amplification.

On a bugfix cycle that inserts bug-reproduction, its FAIL_TO_PASS test survives the fence into the build's tree (or, if the deliverable moves to the run directory, the personas, the phase specs and TestUserSpecs_SourceWritersDeclareWritesSource change in the same landing).
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: every boot strips writes_source from two user phases, so their deliverables are fenced; companion of worktreephase-test-amplification-gap
